name: VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming (1.5B / 7B)

lineage.how_derived: streaming successor of the offline VibeVoice-ASR (arXiv abstract: unified models still mainly supported offline recognition)

purpose: Streaming speaker-attributed ASR: transcribes who said what as speech arrives, without a separate diarization stage, for low-latency voice assistants and agents; customized hotwords for names and technical terms (card, arXiv abstract).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Card states 'licensed under the MIT License' and HF metadata says mit; no LICENSE file opened.

architecture.kind: LLM-based streaming ASR with causal acoustic tokenizer; interleaves fixed-size audio chunks, a small amount of lookahead audio and previous text
architecture.why_this_design: Paper abstract: interleaving chunks, lookahead and previous text lets the model emit 'who said what' as speech arrives, without a separate diarization stage. 7B total is 8.67B parameters by the HF API (decoder plus acoustic tokenizer); the 1.5B has 2.81B.

pc-12gb.notes: 7B in BF16 (17.4 GB) needs a quant

pc-16gb.variant: 7B BF16 17.4 GB needs offload or a quant; 1.5B fits

engine_support.notes: The sibling vibevoice-asr record uses a Qwen2 7B-class decoder; the streaming config of the 7B was not compared line by line.

benchmarks.name: Average WER/CER over five evaluation sets (lowest among compared systems)
benchmarks.score: lowest (value in a chart image only)

benchmarks.name: Speaker attribution: best or tied-best settings

strengths: Speaker attribution and transcription in one streaming model
weaknesses: Evaluation tables are images in the card; numeric WER per language not read
best_for: live meeting transcription with speaker labels
soft.maturity: Microsoft Research; 7B 13k downloads, 1.5B 2k downloads on the HF API 2026-11-19.

tona_fit.reason: Streaming plus diarization in one MIT model fits a meeting-transcription use case no other record covers except the offline vibevoice-asr; the 1.5B fits every class. Needs German numbers and an architecture comparison before commitment.
blockers: VibeVoice ASR architecture not in Tona

open_questions: Numeric WER/CER and DER per language
